title: Wink Reyes Valley mcMMO skill guide
verification: Read-only comparison of live configuration files with the pinned implementation. Player permissions and in-game behavior have not been play-tested.

skills.name: Mining
skills.summary: Mine stone and ores for extra drops and powerful digging abilities.
skills.training: Mine eligible natural stone and ores with a pickaxe.

abilities.name: Double Drops
abilities.description: A chance for an extra copy of normal mining drops.
abilities.activation: Passive while mining eligible blocks.
caveats: Mine natural blocks. Placing and breaking the same blocks does not earn normal bonus drops.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Super Breaker
abilities.description: Mine faster for a short time. Successful bonus-drop rolls can give triple drops.
abilities.activation: Right-click with a pickaxe, then hit an eligible mining block within four seconds.
caveats: Triple drops happen when the bonus succeeds; every block is not guaranteed to drop three items.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Mother Lode
abilities.description: A high-level chance to receive triple mining drops, even outside Super Breaker. If it fails, the normal Double Drops roll still happens.
abilities.activation: Passive while mining eligible blocks.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Blast Mining
abilities.description: Remotely detonate TNT for improved ore recovery, fewer ordinary debris drops, and Mining XP from destroyed ores. Higher ranks improve the ore bonus and can add bonus copies.
abilities.activation: Place TNT, stand safely back, hold a pickaxe or flint and steel, sneak, aim at the TNT, and right-click.
caveats: TNT explodes immediately. Stay back and keep it well away from builds, players and animals.
Aim from a safe distance. The remote range is 100 blocks. Extra ore copies are chance-based.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Bigger Bombs
abilities.description: Makes mcMMO-tracked Blast Mining explosions larger. It improves with your Blast Mining rank.
abilities.activation: Automatic when Blast Mining is used.
caveats: A larger blast damages a larger area. Use it only in a safe mining area.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Demolitions Expertise
abilities.description: Reduces damage from your own Blast Mining TNT. Protection begins at level 500 with the checked settings.
abilities.activation: Passive against your own tracked Blast Mining explosion.
caveats: Protection applies to your own Blast Mining TNT. It does not make ordinary TNT, creepers or other players’ explosives safe.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.
abilities.detail: With the checked settings, protection is 25% at level 500, 50% at 750, and 100% at 1000, for your own tracked Blast Mining TNT only.

skills.name: Woodcutting
skills.summary: Chop trees faster and earn extra wood.
skills.training: Chop natural or grown logs with an axe.

abilities.name: Harvest Lumber
abilities.description: A chance to gain an extra copy of a chopped block's drops.
abilities.activation: Passive when chopping eligible blocks with an axe.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Tree Feller
abilities.description: Chopping a tree can bring down connected logs and nearby tree parts in one action. Harvest Lumber and Clean Cuts can still add drops.
abilities.activation: Right-click with an axe, then hit a valid log within four seconds and chop it.
caveats: Check axe durability first. A worn-out axe can make the ability fail and injure you.
Be careful near treehouses and neighboring trees. Replant afterward. Some tree shapes or protected blocks prevent a complete felling.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Leaf Blower
abilities.description: Instantly breaks leaves and eligible non-wood tree parts when hit with an axe.
abilities.activation: Passive; hit the leaf or eligible tree part with an axe.
caveats: Hold an axe to use it.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Knock on Wood
abilities.description: Improves Tree Feller rewards. Rank 1 keeps sapling/propagule drops from more leaves; rank 2 adds a chance for Minecraft XP orbs from eligible non-log tree components.
abilities.activation: Passive during Tree Feller.
caveats: This improves Tree Feller; punching a tree does not trigger it. Sapling drops are still chance-based.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Clean Cuts
abilities.description: A high-level chance for triple woodcutting drops. If it fails, Harvest Lumber can still award double drops.
abilities.activation: Passive while chopping eligible blocks; also works during Tree Feller.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

skills.name: Herbalism
skills.summary: Harvest more food and learn helpful replanting tricks.
skills.training: Harvest fully grown crops and eligible plants. Let them grow again before harvesting.

abilities.name: Double Drops
abilities.description: Eligible harvests can give extra produce.
abilities.activation: Passive when harvesting eligible mature plants.
caveats: Harvest fully grown crops. Bonus drops depend on the plant; falling sections of tall plants do not all receive the bonus.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Green Terra
abilities.description: A short farming boost: bonus harvests can give triple drops, supported crops replant more reliably, and seeds can turn certain blocks green.
abilities.activation: Right-click with a hoe, then hit or harvest an eligible plant or hit a convertible block within four seconds. While active, hit convertible blocks with wheat seeds available in your inventory.
caveats: Keep the matching seeds or crop item in your inventory for replanting. Sneaking skips replanting.
Greening a block consumes a wheat seed. Not every harvest is guaranteed to give triple drops.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Green Thumb
abilities.description: Harvest with a hoe to try automatically replanting supported crops. Higher ranks replant at a later growth stage. Wheat seeds can also turn certain blocks green.
abilities.unlockLabel: Ranked benefits at level 250; basic replanting can happen earlier
abilities.activation: Harvest with a hoe without sneaking; keep the matching seed/crop item in your inventory or offhand. Cocoa also supports an axe. For manual block conversion, right-click a compatible block while holding wheat seeds.
caveats: Crop replanting can happen before level 250, starting at the earliest growth stage. The level-250 unlock is for ranked growth benefits and manual block conversion.
Keep the matching seeds or crop item in your inventory. Sneaking skips replanting. A failed manual greening attempt still uses its wheat seed.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Farmer's Diet
abilities.description: Restores extra hunger when eating supported farm foods. Each rank adds one hunger point, up to five points (2.5 drumsticks).
abilities.activation: Passive when eating supported foods.
caveats: Extra hunger does not remove the poison from poisonous potatoes.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Hylian Luck
abilities.description: A small chance to find configured treasure when cutting certain plants with a sword.
abilities.unlockLabel: Available from the start; improves with skill
abilities.activation: Break a supported plant or flower-pot block with a sword.
caveats: Use a sword on supported plants. Avoid decorative plants and flower pots around builds.
There is no separate level gate, but the chance starts at zero and grows with your Herbalism level.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Shroom Thumb
abilities.description: A chance to turn dirt, grass or a dirt path into mycelium.
abilities.unlockLabel: Available from the start; improves with skill
abilities.activation: Hold a red or brown mushroom and right-click a compatible block while carrying at least one of each mushroom.
caveats: Every attempt consumes one red and one brown mushroom, even if it fails. The chance starts at zero and grows with your skill.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Verdant Bounty
abilities.description: A high-level chance for a successful bonus harvest to become triple drops outside Green Terra.
abilities.activation: Passive during eligible harvests.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

skills.name: Excavation
skills.training: Dig eligible natural materials, such as dirt, sand and gravel, with a shovel.

abilities.name: Archaeology
abilities.description: Digging can uncover configured treasures and extra Excavation XP. Higher skill levels unlock individual treasure entries; Archaeology ranks improve the Minecraft XP orb bonus when treasure is found.
abilities.activation: Passive when digging eligible natural blocks with a shovel.
caveats: Different treasures need different digging materials and levels. This is a shovel skill, separate from Minecraft’s brush archaeology.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Giga Drill Breaker
abilities.description: Dig faster for a short time, with three chances for treasure and extra Excavation XP from eligible blocks.
abilities.activation: Right-click with a shovel, then hit an eligible excavation block within four seconds.
caveats: It does not dig a 3-by-3 area or triple every ordinary dirt and sand drop. It uses extra tool durability.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

skills.name: Fishing
skills.summary: Catch treasures, get faster bites and learn fishing tricks.
skills.training: Fish with a rod. If warned about overfishing, move where your bobber lands.

abilities.name: Treasure Hunter
abilities.description: Fishing can reel in equipment, valuables and other configured treasures. Higher ranks shift the chances toward better rarity tiers and increase ordinary Minecraft fishing XP.
abilities.activation: Passive when you successfully catch something with a rod.
caveats: A treasure normally replaces the fish you would have caught.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Master Angler
abilities.description: Reduces the wait for a bite. Fishing while seated in a boat adds another small reduction.
abilities.activation: Passive on casting a fishing rod; sit in a boat for the extra bonus.
caveats: The wait still varies. A faster bite is not a guarantee of an immediate catch.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Ice Fishing
abilities.description: Can open a small hole in ordinary ice so you can fish through it.
abilities.activation: Cast onto qualifying ice and reel the grounded hook while aiming at the ice; the ability converts a small patch to water and recasts.
caveats: Use ordinary lake ice. Packed ice and blue ice do not work. It can change a 3-by-3 patch, so avoid decorative ice.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Shake
abilities.description: Hooking a supported creature can shake loose an item and award Fishing XP. Higher ranks improve its success chance.
abilities.activation: Hook a supported living entity with the fishing rod and reel it in.
caveats: Shake hurts the creature and can kill it. Avoid pets, villagers and family members.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Magic Hunter
abilities.description: Some enchantable mcMMO fishing treasures can gain enchantments. Its enchantment odds improve with Treasure Hunter rank.
abilities.activation: Passive when a suitable fishing treasure is found.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Fisherman's Diet
abilities.description: Restores extra hunger when eating supported fish. Each rank adds one hunger point, up to five points (2.5 drumsticks).
abilities.activation: Passive when eating cod, salmon, tropical fish, cooked cod or cooked salmon.
caveats: This does not make pufferfish safe to eat.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

caveats: Keep moving your fishing spot when warned about overfishing. Repeated catches in the same spot can stop earning fish or XP.

skills.name: Swords
skills.summary: Sword attacks gain bleeding, counter-attacks and a short splash-damage ability.
skills.training: Deal damage with a sword to eligible mobs or players.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.description: Sword hits can apply armor-bypassing damage over time. Rank chances are 15%, 33%, 40%, 66%; the duration is about 5 seconds.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: Let melee attacks charge fully for the best chance. Rupture cannot deliver the final killing blow.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Serrated Strikes
abilities.description: Temporarily adds nearby splash damage and attempts Rupture on splash targets. At full strength, splash is one-quarter of the triggering sword damage before armor, with a minimum of 1 damage.
abilities.activation: Right-click with a sword to ready it, then hit a target within 4 seconds. Sneak while right-clicking if your off-hand is occupied.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Counter Attack
abilities.description: While holding a sword, a successful counter damages a living melee attacker for half the incoming damage before armor. Chance increases with Swords level, up to 30% at level 1000.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: A counter hurts the attacker; it does not simply cancel the incoming hit.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Stab
abilities.description: Adds +2.5 sword damage before armor at rank 1 and +4 at rank 2.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Swords Limit Break
abilities.description: Adds extra weapon damage before armor against tougher, better-armored players. Ten ranks; up to +10 damage before armor and other damage reductions at rank 10 against high-quality armor.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: This bonus currently affects player-versus-player combat, not monsters. Armor still reduces the final damage.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

skills.name: Axes
skills.summary: Axe attacks gain extra damage, critical hits and crowd control.
skills.training: Deal damage with an axe. Chopping trees trains Woodcutting instead.

abilities.name: Axe Mastery
abilities.description: Adds +1 axe damage before armor per rank, up to +4.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Critical Strikes
abilities.description: Chance to deal extra axe damage. At full attack strength, a critical is 2× damage against mobs or 1.5× against players. Chance reaches 37.5% at level 1000.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Armor Impact
abilities.description: A 25% chance per armor piece to inflict extra durability damage, growing with rank. Base durability damage is 6.5 × rank before Unbreaking and rounding.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: Damages armor durability rather than adding health damage.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Greater Impact
abilities.description: Against an unarmored target, a 25% chance to add +2 damage before armor and strong knockback.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Skull Splitter
abilities.description: Temporarily splashes axe damage to nearby foes. At full attack strength, splash is half the triggering damage before armor, with a minimum of 1 damage.
abilities.activation: Right-click with an axe to ready it, then hit a target within 4 seconds. Sneak while right-clicking if your off-hand is occupied.
caveats: With an axe ready, hitting a creature triggers Skull Splitter; chopping a tree triggers Tree Feller.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Axes Limit Break
abilities.description: Adds extra weapon damage before armor against tougher, better-armored players. Ten ranks; up to +10 damage before armor and other damage reductions at rank 10 against high-quality armor.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: This bonus currently affects player-versus-player combat, not monsters. Armor still reduces the final damage.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

skills.name: Unarmed
skills.summary: Fight with empty hands and learn defensive tricks.
skills.training: Deal damage with an empty main hand. Holding a random block does not count as empty-handed combat.

abilities.name: Steel Arm Style
abilities.description: Adds punch damage across 20 ranks, from +1 damage before armor at rank 1 to +13.5 at rank 20.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: Temporarily increases fully charged punch damage by 50% and instantly breaks certain weak materials, including excavation-type blocks, snow, and glass.
abilities.activation: Right-click with an empty main hand, then punch a target or suitable block within 4 seconds. Sneak while right-clicking if your off-hand is occupied.
caveats: Keep your main hand empty. Only certain soft blocks break instantly.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Arrow Deflect
abilities.description: Chance to cancel an incoming arrow hit while your main hand is empty. Chance reaches 50% at level 1000.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: Keep your main hand empty. This blocks arrow damage; it does not shoot the arrow back.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Disarm
abilities.description: Punches can knock a player’s held main-hand item onto the ground. Chance reaches 33% at level 1000.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: This affects players. Dropped items can be picked up by others, so be careful around family members’ valuables.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Iron Grip
abilities.description: A chance to keep your held item when another player tries to Disarm you. The chance rises with Unarmed level, reaching 100% at level 1000.
abilities.unlockLabel: Listed rank: level 600; protection can happen earlier
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: The listed first rank is level 600, but protection can happen earlier in this server build.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Block Cracker
abilities.description: While Berserk is active, punching supported brick blocks turns them into their cracked variants.
abilities.activation: Activate Berserk, then punch stone bricks, infested stone bricks, deepslate bricks/tiles, polished blackstone bricks, or nether bricks.
caveats: Use while Berserk is active, so its practical starting point is level 50. Be careful around brick builds.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Unarmed Limit Break
abilities.description: Adds extra weapon damage before armor against tougher, better-armored players. Ten ranks; up to +10 damage before armor and other damage reductions at rank 10 against high-quality armor.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: This bonus currently affects player-versus-player combat, not monsters. Armor still reduces the final damage.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

skills.name: Archery
skills.summary: Improve bow damage and recover some arrows.
skills.training: Shoot eligible targets with a bow. Longer shots award a distance XP multiplier, capped at 50 blocks; fully drawn bow shots are also favored by the XP calculation.

abilities.name: Skill Shot
abilities.description: Adds 10% of the original arrow damage per rank, up to +200% at rank 20, limited to +9 extra damage before armor per hit.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Arrow Retrieval
abilities.description: Chance for arrows fired into a target to be returned as ordinary arrow drops when it dies. Chance reaches 100% at level 1000.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: Infinity arrows are excluded. Recovered arrows are ordinary arrows.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Daze
abilities.description: Bow hits can disorient a player, change their view angle, add 10 seconds of nausea, and add +4 damage before armor. Chance reaches 50% at level 1000.
abilities.unlockLabel: Available from the start; improves with skill
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: Affects players, not monsters. The chance starts at zero and grows with Archery level.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Archery Limit Break
abilities.description: Adds extra weapon damage before armor against tougher, better-armored players. Ten ranks; up to +10 damage before armor and other damage reductions at rank 10 against high-quality armor.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: This bonus currently affects player-versus-player combat, not monsters. Armor still reduces the final damage.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

caveats: This skill has passive bonuses; there is no usable right-click super ability for it in this version.

skills.name: Taming
skills.summary: Train animal companions, especially your tamed wolves.
skills.training: Tame animals and let your own tamed wolves fight while you are online. Ordinary breeding does not award Taming XP.

abilities.name: Beast Lore
abilities.description: Inspect a tameable animal’s health and owner; horse-like animals can also show speed and jump information.
abilities.activation: Left-click a tameable animal while holding a bone. The successful inspection cancels that attack’s damage.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Call of the Wild
abilities.description: Summon a temporary companion: 10 bones for a wolf, 10 raw cod for a cat, or 10 apples for a horse. You can have two summoned wolves, one cat and one horse at a time.
abilities.activation: Crouch and left-click air or a block while holding at least the required item amount in your main hand.
caveats: These companions are temporary: they disappear after four minutes. The summoning ingredients are consumed.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Environmentally Aware
abilities.description: Protects your wolf from falls and helps it escape hazardous blocks by teleporting it back to you.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: It can cancel falls and help a wolf escape hazards, but does not guarantee rescue from lethal lava or fire damage.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Gore
abilities.description: Your wolf’s attack gains another copy of its base hit damage, before other bonuses and armor.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Pummel
abilities.description: Your wolf has a 10% chance to knock back its target.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Fast Food Service
abilities.description: On a wolf’s attack, a 50% chance to heal it by the hit’s original damage amount, up to its maximum health.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Thick Fur
abilities.description: Halves incoming melee/projectile damage to your wolf and extinguishes its burning effect on a fire-tick event.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: This is damage reduction, not immunity to every kind of damage.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Holy Hound
abilities.description: Adds health when your wolf takes magic, poison or wither damage, which can help offset the hit.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
caveats: The original magic damage can still apply. Do not rely on this as immunity or guaranteed net healing.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Shock Proof
abilities.description: Reduces your wolf’s explosion and lightning damage to one-sixth of its previous amount.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Sharpened Claws
abilities.description: Adds +2 damage before armor to your wolf’s attacks.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

caveats: Most combat bonuses apply to your own tamed wolves, not every animal. Summoned companions are temporary.

skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.summary: Improve your chance of reducing fall and attack damage.
skills.training: Gain XP from surviving meaningful falls and successful combat dodges against mobs. Repeating falls at the same spot or grinding the same mob is restricted by anti-farming checks.

abilities.name: Roll
abilities.description: A chance to reduce fall damage by up to 7 damage points (3.5 hearts), after normal fall-damage reductions. Chance scales to 100% at level 1000.
abilities.unlockLabel: Available from the start; improves with skill
abilities.activation: Automatic when landing from a damaging fall, without sneaking.
caveats: Do not jump from lethal heights to test it. A roll can fail, and cannot save a fall that remains fatal after the reduction.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Graceful Roll
abilities.description: Sneaking doubles Roll’s success chance and doubles the maximum reduction to 14 damage points (7 hearts). With configured scaling it reaches 100% chance at level 500.
abilities.unlockLabel: Sneaking version of Roll; no separate unlock
abilities.activation: Hold sneak when you land from a fall.
caveats: Sneak before landing. It still cannot save a fall that remains fatal after the reduction.
abilities.verification: Server configuration files checked 2026-10-12; implementation pinned to mcMMO 2.3.003-SNAPSHOT.

abilities.name: Dodge
abilities.description: Chance to halve incoming attack damage, with a minimum of 1 damage still taken. Chance scales to 20% at level 1000.
abilities.activation: Passive: works automatically when its conditions are met.

common.intro: Level up by doing the things you already enjoy. Some bonuses happen automatically; active abilities give you a short boost before a cooldown. You can train every skill.
common.activation: Hold the right tool, use/right-click to ready it, then do the matching action within four seconds. On a phone or controller, use your controls’ equivalent Use/Interact action. If it will not ready with something in your offhand, sneak or empty your offhand.
common.duration: Most timed abilities last 3 seconds at level 50, 12 seconds at level 500, and 22 seconds at level 1000 or higher, before special perks.
common.cooldown: The usual timed abilities have a 4-minute base cooldown after they finish. Blast Mining has a 1-minute base cooldown. Check /mccooldown for your current timers.
common.levelCap: Level 1000 is a common bonus milestone, not a hard skill cap.
common.combat: Let melee attacks charge fully for the best damage and bonus chances. Damage numbers are Minecraft damage points: 2 points equal one heart.
common.together: The Together and Weekend XP update is built and tested, awaiting installation. The existing Together setting is saved on, but runtime activation is still pending. The new green-bar bonus and live indicator are not installed.

party.sharing: At party level 10, the leader can use /party xpshare equal to share skill XP with nearby eligible party members within 75 blocks. /party xpshare none turns it off. The pool is split among teammates; it does not give everyone a full copy of the earned XP.
